`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
A component library is not “we imported shadcn.” It is a contract: the same empty state, the same save spinner, the same button API, every time. Omnipus has the first half of that contract (Radix primitives, tokens, `cn()`) and keeps rewriting the second half on each screen.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

## Maturity verdict: 2 (emerging)

The kit is real — 26 primitive families in `src/components/ui/`, Radix-wrapped, imported from 122 files. It is not yet a library. `cva` exists in 2 files, loading/empty/error are invented per screen, there is no Storybook or catalog, and `@omnipus/ui` exports four primitives. Past copy-paste; short of a defined system.

Report: `/Users/danielpiatkowski/AI-Agent-Workspace/omnipus/wt-release-session/docs/internal/ui-audit-2026-09-17/lane-b-library.md`

## Top 3 fixes

1. **Make loading / empty / error a library API, then delete the copies.** One `Skeleton`, one `EmptyState` with an action, one query error, one save indicator, `Button loading`, invalid styles on `Input`. This is the inconsistency users actually see.
2. **Freeze the primitive contract and finish the kit.** Written checklist (`cva` + `cn` + `forwardRef` + kebab-case), apply it to `Command` / `Popover` / `Badge`, add Tooltip / Skeleton / Field, and move domain widgets (`ModelSelector`, `RestartConfirmDialog`, …) out of `ui/`.
3. **Give the library a catalog.** Markdown inventory now; Storybook next. Export what `ui/` actually contains from `@omnipus/ui`, or stop calling that stub the design system.

**Evidence:** file counts from `find` (283 production TSX; 26 primitive families; 233 screen-specific); absences (Storybook, `components.json`, Tooltip) from glob/rg returning zero. Sign-in dialog internals beyond their header comments remain UNVERIFIED.
